title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: Images 2 and 10; step "layers"; focus includes r1–r4
findings.title: The layer explanation is buried below all four stage definitions
findings.problem: The opening step displays every stage-definition paragraph before its own caption. At 360px width, the caption starts roughly 650 CSS pixels down and the controls roughly 820 pixels down—below a 360×800 viewport. Clicking Watch starts autoplay, but its timer accounts only for the caption, not the substantial intervening text. Students must scroll past later teaching content to reach the explanation currently being narrated.
findings.fix: Remove r1–r4 from the "layers" focus. Keep the cross-sections, legend and staging caveat; introduce each definition in its dedicated stage step.

assessment: No blocking clinical error found. The opening explainer step has a phone-layout and pacing problem.
